items.title: T-Mobile US (TMUS) Reaches First 5G Standalone Roaming Milestone
items.summary: T-Mobile US (NasdaqGS: TMUS) and India-based Jio reported the world’s first 5G Standalone roaming connection in a recent cross-border trial. The roaming link used pure 5G Standalone cores on both networks, allowing compatible devices to connect without falling back to 4G infrastructure. The partners highlighted potential benefits for consumer and enterprise users who rely on low-latency applications when travelling between the US and India. items.title: Why Does AT&T Stock Cost Less Than A Slower-Growing Verizon?
items.summary: AT&T (T) grows faster than Verizon, yet it trades at a far lower multiple of earnings. In its five-company peer group it ranks second on growth and margin but only third on its earnings multiple. Management calls that a disparity, and it has raised its buyback to take advantage of it.

items.title: Is Verizon Stock Cheap, Or Is Its Cash Already Spoken For?
items.summary: Verizon Communications (VZ) trades near $48 a share and generated free cash worth 10.0% of its market value over the last twelve months. The median S&P 500 company manages 4.5%. A gap that wide usually means one of two things: a bargain, or a business the market expects to shrink. Verizon is neither, quite. The cash is real, and it is not all yours.
